title: Interactive product database migration verification
redaction: schema names, migration hashes, and test-observed row counts only

emptySchemaMigration.observedBehavior: runMigrations applies 0001 and 0002, then reruns both idempotently without hash drift.

legacySchemaMigration.source: 0001-only schema with one legacy experiment row

schemaCapabilities: evidence_plane enum separates MAINNET_HISTORICAL, SHANNON_FORWARD, and SHANNON_EXECUTION
research_sessions stores token and CSRF hashes only
experiments support session ownership without requiring a wallet identity
experiment_policy_versions preserve strategy association per configuration
replay_runs and replay_decisions persist bounded replay provenance and decisions
metric_runs carry evidence_plane, replay_run_id, promotion_scope, and provenance
comparison_sets and comparison_items persist user-selected assessments without computed vanity scores
historical_source_manifests persist source digests and row counts, not bulk raw source rows
securityNotes: No raw session token, CSRF value, connection string, or credential is stored in evidence.
No mainnet transaction capability is introduced by this migration.
Raw historical owner fields are not introduced into the EdgeLab database model.
